[[File:Alberto Cassano.jpg|thumb|Alberto Cassano]]
'''Alberto Cassano''' (23 January 1935 &ndash; 12 July 2014) was an [[Argentina|Argentine]] engineer and academic. He was a professor at the [[Universidad Nacional del Litoral]] during most of his career. He founded the program [[CONICET]]. He founded the Instituto de Desarrollo Tecnológico para la Industria Química (INTEC) and the Centro Regional de Investigación y Desarrollo (CERIDE).

In 2006, he received the [[Bernardo Houssay Award|Houssay Career Award]] for outstanding research work.<ref>{{Cite news |url=https://www.pagina12.com.ar/diario/ciencia/19-95351-2007-11-28.html |title=Platos que fueron bien lavados |trans-title=Plates That Were Well Cleaned |newspaper=[[Página/12]] |language=Spanish |date=2007-11-28 |access-date=2020-04-24}}</ref>

Cassano died in [[Santa Fe Province]] following a long illness, aged 79.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.ellitoral.com/index.php/id_um/102654-|title=Falleció el científico Alberto Cassano|publisher=Allitoral.com|accessdate=15 July 2014}} {{in lang|es}}</ref>
